description:
## User decision and approval
User explicitly requested this issue to block epic closure: remove Mailpit and Mattermost servers from ZAQ tests and validate with a Mattermost stub and SMTP stub or Swoosh test adapter. This supersedes the real-server acceptance requirement of completed zaq-juu.7. It approves this specific change to existing test behavior; it does not authorize unrelated generator or Agent synchronization repairs. Keep .7 as historical evidence of delivered/pushed work. Real Mattermost server compatibility belongs in jido_chat_mattermost. Do not run Mix while the user is running mix test; wait for their result/release.

## Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add
Replace external boundaries in test/support/channel_file_delivery.ex and the existing disk_file_delivery_integration_test.exs/email_file_delivery_integration_test.exs, preserving the two reusable Channels modules. Reuse/extend test/support/mattermost_history_fixture.ex or its existing HTTP harness for attachment upload/post/error responses and request capture; prefer scoped per-test stub state. Reuse SMTP/Swoosh test support (config/test.exs already selects Swoosh.Adapters.Test). Remove Mailpit and Mattermost provisioning plus their dedicated PostgreSQL service, bootstrap credentials and Docker image pulls from test/support/file_delivery/, scripts/test_channel_files.sh and .github/workflows/elixir-ci.yml as appropriate. Keep ZAQ's own test database and unrelated CI infrastructure. Remove obsolete scripts/helpers instead of retaining a hidden real-server requirement. Ensure these tests run in normal CI without external provider containers and are not silently excluded by the existing integration tag.

## Tests to add before implementation
Adapt the seven existing scenarios: selected one of two signed Disk Records; exact attachment bytes/name/MIME; routing/thread/audience and final receipt identifiers; empty attachments; two concurrent journeys per channel and mixed Mattermost/email. Assert upload/post payloads and emitted Swoosh email or captured SMTP MIME rather than claiming actual recipient receipt. Preserve no cross-contamination, source preservation, and cleanup isolation. Retain provider error/status/no-resend regression coverage; never replace tests with unconditional success stubs or remove safety assertions.

## Branches/paths validated
Keep real datasource APIs, grants, signed Records, trusted Outgoing Event, NodeRouter, Materialization, Channels preparation, Jido adapter and email composition. Stub only external provider HTTP/SMTP or the Swoosh transport boundary. No mocked internal authorization/dispatch/materialization, no Agent/LLM ingress expansion, no production behavior change or new production test seam without separately justified evidence. Real provider protocol/readback claims remain upstream, not asserted by simulated responses.

## Mocking plan
Mattermost: existing isolated HTTP fixture/harness extended only as needed to capture and validate uploads/posts and provider errors. Email: existing process-scoped Swoosh test adapter or lightweight SMTP stub selected using established configuration injection. No Application environment mutation, global Mox, shared default connectors/mailboxes/files, fixed sleeps or fake concurrency evidence. Use private SQL sandbox ownership and explicit process allowances.

## Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content
Update helper moduledocs, docs/services/channels.md and affected Engine summary, CI/script instructions, PR6 evidence and Beadwork acceptance wording. Coordinate already prepared but uncommitted documentation edits under .8; do not discard them. Clearly distinguish ZAQ integration contracts from upstream real-server compatibility tests. Remove obsolete Docker provisioning/readback claims.

## Action reuse assessment
Test-only work; no new production operation or Action. Concrete reuse candidates: MattermostHistoryFixture.http/3 and provider test infrastructure referenced by zaq-o9d; config/test.exs Swoosh.Adapters.Test; existing email_bridge_test.exs Swoosh adapter patterns and smtp_sender_test.exs helpers; current ChannelFileDelivery signed-record and journey fixtures. Decision: extend/reuse external test boundaries while retaining production ownership and permission contracts. Verify actual fixture APIs and @moduledoc before implementation; avoid a parallel generic provider framework.

## Validation and delivery
Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/services/channels.md, docs/documentation.md and authoritative WORKFLOW_AGENT validation lifecycle. User approval above satisfies only this replacement's existing-test gate. Run mix q and isolated replacement/regression tests after user releases their running Mix process, review changes, commit with zaq-juu.9 and push origin/feat/channel-files; verify remote before closure and synchronize tracking. Validate normal fork CI executes the replacement tests with no Mattermost/Mailpit image downloads. Then .8 must redo final docs/review as needed, coverage handoff and final validation against the replacement. No epic closure until .9 and .8 requirements complete; existing coverage timeout approval and unrelated failures remain separately tracked.
